newsList.title: Community Discord Server
newsList.body: Recently we have started an official Arsenal speedrunning discord server where you can talk to other speedrunners and just normal players of the game. Feel free to join and talk: https://www.discord.gg/UGbVv7xaKG

threadList.name: add the operation infiltration part 2 event to the page

categories.name: Headshots Only
categories.rules:
- Timer starts upon round starting OR joining mid way through a round

- Win the round by reaching 33 kills

- Timer ends when the round ends. You MUST win the round.

**Note**
- Video proof is mandatory for the run to be accepted within the Top 10 and a full video is required for 1st place runs.
- Milliseconds are not required
- Timer is either based on when the round starts or from when you deploy in the middle of a round
- Use of Purple team is not allowed for the select few who may find this board and have it.
- VIP Servers are not allowed.
- Getting a lot of your kills from friends or suspicious players is not allowed. 
- Games with bugged spawns will count as the late join category.
- 1st place runs must have the player names visible for verification.
